preview.text: England Champions play West Indies Champions in a T20 match at Sharjah Cricket Stadium, where the usual first-innings score in the 82 recorded T20 matches is 153. West Indies Champions won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 32 degrees.

summary.text: Moeen Ali scored 41 off 28 balls as ENGCH posted 154-10, with Dwayne Bravo taking 2 for 24. Lendl Simmons then hit 55 off 33 balls to lead WICH to 139-3, securing a 7 wkts victory despite Ravi Bopara taking 1 for 11.
